arms.label: A5 — the shipped path: applicability, findings, the BA's questions and the refresh

configuration.searcher: production BM25 options (createInMemoryBM25) over rule id + summary, standing in for governingIndexRetriever
configuration.applicability: decideApplicability, rules with production's source line
configuration.questions: openGoverningPairs + openFindingPairs + buildGoverningQuestions: production's question text
configuration.answers: a question linking a rule with a baAnswer is given that answer; rejudgeAnswered + answersForApplyingPairs + applySettlements; findings produced again when a settlement applied
configuration.reading: readFindings: status as verdict, the verified clause as citation

codePath: governing/findings-store.ts findingPairsOf + governing/findings.ts evaluateRequirementFindings (the refresh after an answer)
